evidence: Normalization logic in Float128::toPackedFloat causes precision loss for floating numbers with high decimal places and digits > 38

n always results in false and those numbers will be wrongly stored in M_MANTISSA range instead of the L_MANTISSA range. This results in a significant precision loss. To further confirm this issue the sponsor has confirmed that floating points with 38 < digits < 72 are valid inputs for this library as seen [here](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/00924b7c-9ed2-46d8-8b3f-da9495b36626)
